│                                                                              │
│   Set up Bint  Step 6/7 · Git presence                                       │
│                                                                              │
│   Where do Bint's files live in Git?                                         │
│                                                                              │
│   ( ) track — committed for the whole team (default)                         │
│ ▸ (•) local — used on this machine only                                      │
│                                                                              │
│     Untracked files (.bint/, skills, hooks, .mcp.json…) go to                │
│     .git/info/exclude so git status stays clean; tracked files Bint          │
│     edits (AGENTS.md…) get skip-worktree (a pull may complain if             │
│     upstream changes them). Switch back later with bint init --git           │
│     track.                                                                   │
│                                                                              │
│                                                                              │
